To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
SNF8 is a novel regulator of the TRPC6 cation channel.
SNF8 binds to the amino-terminal region of TRPC6 and that SNF8 modulates the channel activity of TRPC6.
SNF8 interacts with TRPC channels, and that the SNF8-TRPC6 interaction is required for the enhancement of TRPC6 channel function.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification and characterization of the molecular mechanisms underlying the regulation of ion channel function.
the identification of new binding partners of TRPC6 and how these interactions modulate TRPC6 channel activity.
the role of SNF8 in regulating TRPC6 channel activity.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this is a novel regulator of a TRPC channel, and that it is a novel interaction partner of TRPC channels in general.
